column1: # Fault replays for harness-kit itself, run by plugins/harness-kit/scripts/replay-faults.sh
# (locally, and in this public repository's CI). One per line, tab-separated:
# Each puts back a break an earlier increment proved, and names the tests/validate.sh case

column5: failing check: blocks with the FAIL line as feedback
4 failures in a row: 4th allows the stop and prints the budget line
Write a JWT: denied, value not echoed
check-reviewed: an edited old line fails (append-only)
ship.sh: stops on red CI with the run's URL; main untouched
replay-faults: a SURVIVED fault exits non-zero

column3: if (text === null) return notFound(`${DEFECTS} did not exist${src.where}`);
column4: if (text === null) return escapedDefects({ where: src.where, read: () => "" }, when);
column5: harness-metrics: no defects.tsv: escaped defects are NOT FOUND, not 0
install-hooks: the commit-msg hook refuses a message check-commits would fail, with the fix; --no-verify commits
ship.sh: a non-PASS review: commits its line with the standard message, stops and shows the verdict
ship.sh: a stale index is regenerated and committed before the review, through the commit-msg hook
upgrade.sh: writes the pin commit draft (Breaks kept, Decision relabelled Upstream, numbers on Told) and it passes the commit-msg hook
git-guard: git push in the real working tree is denied, however it is written
approve-brief.sh: refuses without a terminal and writes nothing; with no brief it says to run /plan
review.sh: the input holds the brief and whether its approval matches
ship.sh: no brief, or an approval that does not match, stops before the review with the exact fix
